# Raminda Kariyawasam - Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Raminda Kariyawasam is a full-stack software engineer and Associate Software Engineer at NSBM Green University in Sri Lanka. He builds AI-enabled university platforms, optimization systems, secure enterprise applications, and production infrastructure. He graduated from the University of Plymouth with a BSc (Hons) in Software Engineering in 2025.

## Featured engineering

- UMIS Student Portal / GreenMate AI - Next.js portal with an authenticated Gemini function-calling loop, server-owned student identity, tool-level controls, rate limiting, and usage accounting. Built as part of the NSBM development team; private source.
- NSBM RAG Bot - PHP retrieval assistant using Gemini File Search, with an embeddable widget, dataset administration, signed requests, origin controls, and rate limiting. Built as part of the NSBM development team; private source.
- Timetable Generator Gen2 - Next.js and private FastAPI system using OR-Tools CP-SAT for full-semester timetabling, read-only UMIS access, and explicit allocation conflicts. Built as part of the NSBM development team; private source.
- UMIS 2.0 - Implemented Next.js/NestJS/PostgreSQL/Redis/MinIO platform foundation plus a clearly separated future architecture and specification set. Built as part of the NSBM development team; private source.
- US Deed Management - In-development Angular and Spring Boot prototype for multi-county deed search, saved research, administration, and bulk-ingestion workflows. Built as part of a client team; private source.

## NSBM systems

Built as part of the NSBM development team: GreenMate and the UMIS Student Portal, NSBM RAG Bot, Timetable Generator Gen2, UMIS 2.0 foundation, ExamTrack, Enroll-Now Portal, Research Publications Portal, Library Management Portal, Registration Kiosk, NSBM Intranet, Job Portal, Timetable Generator Gen1, Campus Lunch Ordering, BOC Payment Portal, and SDG Widget.

NSBM repositories are private and intentionally have no public source links.

## Public team projects

- [Doc-Assist Pro](https://github.com/KADRDulmin/Doc-Assist-Pro) - Node/Express/PostgreSQL API, React Native patient and doctor clients, Angular administration, appointments, and recommendation workflow
- LiteraNet - Angular/Node/MongoDB library workflows, Socket.IO notifications, Docker, and k6 test assets; the team repository is not anonymously accessible and is intentionally unlinked
- [EduStay](https://github.com/KADRDulmin/EduStay) - PHP/MySQL accommodation listings, reservations, map view, and landlord/warden/student/admin roles
- [Bus Black Box mobile](https://github.com/KADRDulmin/Bus-Black-Box-Mobile-App) and [IoT system](https://github.com/KADRDulmin/BUS-BLACK-BOX-SECURITY-SYSTEM) - Flutter monitoring client and Firebase-backed sensor prototype

These are team projects; the portfolio does not claim sole ownership.

## Technical focus

- AI and optimization: Gemini function calling, retrieval-augmented generation and File Search, OR-Tools CP-SAT, prompt/tool controls, local speech deployment design
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, Flutter, responsive UI, accessibility
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Java, Spring Boot, PHP, Python, FastAPI
- Data and security: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Entra ID, OAuth/JWT, RBAC, audit trails
- Operations: Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS, Linux, Apache/Nginx, Sentry, migrations, observability
